name: Battle NPC
main_effect:
[Start of Your Turn] If you have 2 or less memory, set it to 3.
[On Play] By placing 1 level 3 Digimon card from your hand under this Tamer, ＜Draw 1＞ (Draw 1 card from your deck.)
[Start of Your Main Phase] If you don't have a Digimon, by playing 1 play cost 3 or lower Digimon card from under this Tamer without paying the cost, delete this Tamer.
source_effect: Security Effect [Security] Play this card without paying the cost.
